name: runloop-tracer
description: Record Claude Code sessions (prompts, tool calls, subagents, permissions) into a local Runloop world and replay them. Observe-only: it never blocks or changes Claude Code.

runtime_url.title: Runloop runtime URL
runtime_url.description: Where the local Runloop runtime listens. Loopback addresses only; anything else is refused.

enabled.title: Trace sessions
enabled.description: Turn tracing off without uninstalling the plugin.

trace_prompts.title: Record prompt text
trace_prompts.description: Store your prompts (marked sensitive). Off stores a placeholder instead.
